main.description: ADR-0014 Phase 5: migrate a did:web actor to did:plc. PDS builds genesis op with rotation key from D1 (ADR-0010 custody), signs with ES256K, computes DID, and registers with plc.etzhayyim.com. Client never touches key material.

actor.description: actor name from deps.toml [[mitama_actors]] (e.g. adr, legal-aid)

handle.description: atproto handle to embed in DID document alsoKnownAs (e.g. adr.etzhayyim.com)

dryRun.description: if true: build + sign genesis op, compute DID, but do NOT register with plc.etzhayyim.com and do NOT persist rotation mapping

existingRotationKeys.description: optional: pre-existing did:key rotation keys (default: load from D1 signing_keys by actor name)

genesisCid.description: dag-cbor CID of the genesis operation

plcUrl.description: plc.etzhayyim.com resolve URL for the new DID

legacyDid.description: previous did:web that the actor used (grandfathered 6 months)

registered.description: true if DID was successfully POSTed to plc.etzhayyim.com (false in dryRun or if already exists)

errors.name: ActorNotFound
errors.description: actor name not found in deps.toml [[mitama_actors]]

errors.name: RotationKeyUnavailable
errors.description: D1 signing_keys has no rotation key for this actor, or key grace window not satisfied

errors.name: PlcDirectoryUnreachable
errors.description: plc.etzhayyim.com POST failed (network / auth / rate limit)

errors.name: DidCollision
errors.description: computed did:plc hash collides with existing DID (extremely rare; retry with new rotation key)
